render_back.render_back_text:
The methodology of the Index is subject to regular review at least annually. Any methodology review of the Index Methodology is regular and occurs at least annually. If a methodology change need is identified within a review, that need is a change need for the Index Methodology, and a review-identified methodology change exists for that need. Such a change is made in accordance with the Solactive Methodology Policy and announced on the Solactive website in the announcements section.

The following are example conditions for a methodology change need: underlying market change, economic reality change, obsolete assumption, obsolete factor, and no longer reflects reality. Underlying market change and economic reality change relate to the Index; obsolete assumption and obsolete factor relate to the Index Methodology; and no longer reflects reality is associated with accuracy, reliability, and appropriateness.
